tab1.tooltip_append_to_destination: Add sorted files to the destination directory without deleting existing contents (conflict handling rules will apply). If unchecked, the existing content will be set aside after confirmation, in the _purged subdirectory of the destination.
tab1.tooltip_hashing_parallelism: Number of files whose CRC32 is computed at the same time while identifying them against the DAT. One file at a time suits a hard disk drive best; several speed the analysis up on an SSD, NVMe drive or fast NAS. The result of the sort never depends on this setting.
tab1.tooltip_verify_sha1: When the DAT provides a SHA-1 (Redump DATs do), also computes it for each file identified by its CRC32 and size: a different SHA-1 loses the match. Safer but slower: each identified file is read again, and a file in a ZIP archive has to be decompressed (only the SHA-1 of files outside archives is cached).
tab1.tooltip_verify_archive_contents: Without this option, a file in an archive (ZIP, 7z, RAR) is identified by the CRC32 the archive records, without being read, and a MAME set is copied as it is: a damaged archive whose header is right passes for complete. With it, every file of every archive is decompressed and compared with that CRC32; a file, or a MAME set, whose content does not match is isolated as damaged. The first analysis is much slower: every archive is decompressed. The result is then kept in the cache, and only a new or changed archive is read again.
tab1.tooltip_match_chd_by_name: A Redump DAT describes the tracks (.bin, .cue) of a disc, not the CHD file that compresses them: a CHD is therefore never recognized there by its hash. This option links a CHD to the DAT game that has exactly its name. The content is not verified: the status says so, and these games are counted apart in the DAT completion (neither found by hash nor missing).
tab1.tooltip_isolate_unmatched: Writes the non-conforming files (missing from the DAT, or named outside the convention) to the _unmatched folder of the destination. Unchecked, the sort leaves them in the source: they stay visible in the results, but are neither written nor counted in the volume written.
tab1.tooltip_verify_copies: Re-reads each file copied, extracted from an archive or moved to another volume, and compares its CRC32 with that of the data read from the source. On a mismatch, the copy is deleted and the source is kept. Hard and symbolic links are not verified. Slows the sort down, since each file is read again.

tab3.tooltip_filter_countries: Strict country filtering: immediately exclude any game not originating from countries or regions in your priority list.

tab3.tooltip_tiebreak_order: Order in which the criteria separate the versions of a game: the first criterion that distinguishes them picks the kept version. The places of the language and the country also decide which of the two comes first, the language and country filters included.

tab3.tooltip_tiebreak_order_mame: Order in which the criteria separate a parent MAME set and its clones: the first criterion that distinguishes them picks the kept set. It only applies to MAME sets: by default, the parent chosen by the MAME developers wins, unless it is incomplete, less well emulated than a clone, a bootleg or a hack. Put the language or the country above “Parent rather than clone” to prefer the versions of your region.
tab3.tooltip_tiebreak_reset_mame: Restore the default order of the criteria of MAME sets

tab3.tooltip_tiebreak_convention: Each convention has its own order, made of the criteria that can separate its versions. The order of the convention of the collection is shown; the others are saved for your other collections.

tiebreak.tooltip_good_dump_nointro: A dump without fault rather than a bad dump [b].

tiebreak.tooltip_original_release_nointr: The retail release rather than a beta, a prototype, a demo, a pirate (Pirate), a hack (Hack) or a re-release.

cli.description: RomSieve command line: simulates (by default) or runs a sort from the configuration of the interface or from a profile.
cli.command_run: Simulates the sort (nothing is written), or runs it with --execute.
cli.command_undo: Undoes the last real sort recorded in the operation journal.
cli.command_quarantine: Shows the quarantine of the purges of the destination (_purged folder), and empties it with --empty --yes.
cli.option_empty: Deletes the content of the quarantine for good. Requires --yes.
cli.command_dat: Writes the filtered DAT of the catalog: the games of the DAT the options would keep, without reading the source nor the destination.
cli.option_output_dat: DAT file to write: .xml (Logiqx XML) or .dat (CLRMAMEPRO); for MAME software lists, the folder where a DAT per list is written.
cli.output_dat_extension: The filtered DAT must be a .xml or .dat file: {path}
cli.output_softlist_folder: The DATs of MAME software lists are written into a folder, a DAT per list: {path} is not a folder.
cli.output_lot_folder: The DATs of a lot are written into a folder, a DAT per DAT of the lot: {path} is not a folder.
cli.mirror_requires_folder_per_dat: --dir-dat-mirror places the folder of each DAT under the folders of its path: a folder per DAT is needed (folder_per_dat of the configuration).
cli.dat_only_requires_lot: --dat-only chooses DATs of a lot: the DAT must be a folder of No-Intro, Redump or TOSEC DATs.
cli.dat_only_unknown: No DAT of the lot is named {name}. DATs of the lot: {names}.
cli.catalog_dat_empty: The options keep no game of the catalog: no DAT was written.
cli.catalog_dat_written: Filtered DAT of the catalog written: {kept} games kept out of {total} ({path})
cli.quarantine_not_marked: {path} is not a destination of RomSieve: its _purged folder is not a quarantine, and it is never emptied.
cli.quarantine_empty_requires_yes: Emptying the quarantine deletes its content for good: undoing the sorts that purged it can no longer put it back. Add --yes to confirm.
cli.option_config: Configuration file (by default, the one of the interface). The profiles, the sort journals and the CRC cache used are those next to this file.
cli.option_quiet: Only shows the warnings, the errors and the summary.
cli.option_profile: Configuration profile to use instead of config.json (profiles directory next to the configuration).
cli.option_source: Source directory (replaces the one of the configuration).
cli.option_destination: Destination directory (replaces the one of the configuration).
cli.option_dat: DAT file, or folder of DATs: a lot of No-Intro, Redump or TOSEC DATs, or MAME software lists (replaces the one of the configuration).
cli.option_dat_recursive: Also reads the DATs of the subfolders of the folder of DATs (a lot).
cli.option_dat_only: Only sorts with this DAT of the lot, named by the name of its header (case ignored); a repeatable option, which replaces the DATs unchecked in the configuration.
cli.option_dir_dat_mirror: Places the folder of each DAT of the lot under the folders of its path in the folder of DATs (refused without a folder per DAT).
cli.option_chd: Folder of the CHDs of a MAME collection (replaces the one of the configuration).
cli.option_categories: Category file of the MAME machines, catver.ini or catlist.ini (replaces the one of the configuration).
cli.option_ratings: Rating file of the MAME machines, bestgames.ini (replaces the one of the configuration).
cli.option_mode: Transfer mode (replaces the one of the configuration).
cli.option_execute: Actually runs the sort. Without this option, the command only simulates it and writes nothing.
cli.option_purge: Empties a non-empty destination before the sort: its content is moved into its _purged subdirectory, and the undo command puts it back. Requires --execute and --yes.
cli.option_yes: Confirms a destructive operation: purge of the destination, undo of the last sort, emptying of the quarantine.
cli.option_report: Exports the report of the run (.json or .csv file).
cli.option_miss_list: Exports the list of the ROMs missing from the DAT (.txt or .csv file).
cli.option_fixdat: Exports the fixdat of the missing ROMs (Logiqx XML DAT); for a lot of DATs or MAME software lists, the folder where a fixdat per DAT or per list is written.
cli.report_extension: The report must be a .json or .csv file: {path}
cli.miss_list_extension: The Miss List must be a .txt or .csv file: {path}
cli.export_requires_dat: The Miss List and the fixdat require a DAT file (--dat or configuration).
config.newer_version: {path} was written by a newer version of RomSieve (format {version}, this version reads up to format {current}): the options it does not know are ignored.
config.unreadable_preserved: {path} cannot be read: RomSieve opens with the default settings, which will replace it when it closes. Its content is kept in {copy}.
config.unreadable_kept: {path} cannot be read or copied: RomSieve opens with the default settings, without replacing it. Fix or delete it, then restart RomSieve.
cli.no_source: No source directory: set --source or choose it in the interface.
cli.no_destination: No destination directory: set --destination or choose it in the interface.
cli.dest_not_empty: The destination is not empty: {path}. Add --append to complete it, or --purge --yes to empty it before the sort.
cli.purge_requires_yes: The purge of {path} moves all its content into its _purged subdirectory: confirm it with --yes.
cli.summary: Summary: {scanned} files scanned, {valid} kept, {excluded} excluded, {unmatched} unmatched, {duplicates} duplicates, {errors} in error.
cli.summary_dat: DAT: {matched} ROMs present out of {total} ({pct} %), {missing} missing.
cli.summary_dat_lot_nothing: {count} other DATs of the lot without any game found.
cli.summary_already_in_destination: Of which {count} duplicates already in the destination, not written again: choose an empty destination, add --purge --yes or set the conflicts to "Overwrite" to write them.
cli.dry_run_done: Simulation finished: no file was written. Add --execute to sort.
cli.journal_written: Operation journal: {path} (the undo command undoes this sort).
cli.undo_summary: Last sort: {date}, {count} operations, {mode_name} mode, from {source_dir} to {dest_dir}.
cli.undo_requires_yes: Add --yes to undo this sort. The moved files will return to their original location, the created files will be deleted and the content set aside by a purge will be put back.
cli.undo_report: Operations undone: {undone} out of {total}, not undone or to check: {issues}.
cli.undo_resume: The last undo of this sort left {count} operations to retry: only they will be replayed.
cli.undo_retry_hint: {count} operations can be retried: close the files concerned or free their original location, then run "undo --yes" again.
cli.option_help: Shows the help and the usage.

dialog.dest_foreign_html:
This directory does not seem to have been created by RomSieve.

Destination: {dest_dir}

It lacks the marker that RomSieve leaves in the destinations of its sorts (hidden file .romsieve). It may be a directory chosen by mistake, or a destination created by an earlier version of RomSieve.

Its content will be set aside in _purged, not deleted. Do you confirm that this is the destination of your collection?

cli.option_force_foreign_purge: Allows purging a destination that RomSieve did not mark (without the .romsieve file of its sorts).
cli.purge_foreign: The destination {path} was not created by RomSieve (no .romsieve file): add --force-foreign-purge if it is the destination of your collection.

filters.tooltip_content: Check what you want to keep; the files of an unchecked category are excluded from the sort.
filters.tooltip_keep_tosec_modifications: Keep scene-modified releases: cracks [cr], trainers [t], hacks [h], pirate releases [p], and fixes [f]. Unchecked, they are excluded.
filters.tooltip_keep_tosec_translations: Keep unofficial fan translation releases flagged with [tr] or [t+]. Unchecked, they are excluded.
filters.tooltip_keep_tosec_dev: Keep preliminary development builds (alpha, beta, prototype, preview). Unchecked, they are excluded.
filters.tooltip_keep_tosec_demos: Keep commercial rolling demos, kiosk samples, and playable demos. Unchecked, they are excluded.
filters.tooltip_keep_tosec_pd: Keep Public Domain (PD), freeware, and shareware software. Unchecked, it is excluded.
filters.tooltip_keep_nointro_modificatio: Keep fan-modified ROMs and romhacks marked with (Hack). Unchecked, they are excluded. Also applies to modified MAME sets (hack).
filters.tooltip_keep_nointro_translation: Keep unofficial translation patches marked with (Translated...). Unchecked, they are excluded.
filters.tooltip_keep_nointro_dev: Keep preliminary development versions: (Beta), (Proto), (Sample), and (Pre-Release). Unchecked, they are excluded. Also applies to MAME prototypes and beta versions.
filters.tooltip_keep_nointro_demos: Keep kiosk and retail demonstration samples: (Demo), (Kiosk), and (Taikenban). Unchecked, they are excluded. Also applies to MAME demos.
filters.tooltip_keep_nointro_pirate: Keep counterfeit cartridges and bootleg pirate releases marked with (Pirate). Unchecked, they are excluded. Also applies to MAME bootlegs.
filters.tooltip_keep_nointro_unl: Keep unofficial creations unlicensed by the console manufacturer: (Unl), (Homebrew), and (Aftermarket). Unchecked, they are excluded.
filters.tooltip_keep_nointro_rereleases: Keep modern emulated re-releases on recent platforms: (Virtual Console), (Switch Online), (Classic Mini), and hotel kiosks (LodgeNet). Unchecked, they are excluded.
filters.mame_card_hint: Settings of the MAME sets alone, from the MAME DAT. The sets also follow the No-Intro / Redump settings below.
filters.mame_card_softlist_hint: Without effect on the software of a MAME list: these settings only apply to the machines of a MAME DAT. The software follow the No-Intro / Redump settings below.
filters.mame_card_inactive_hint: Apply with a MAME DAT: BIOS, emulation, cabinet, categories, ratings, size… Choose a MAME DAT in the Collection step to set them.
filters.tooltip_no_effect_mame_category: No effect on a MAME set: a MAME description never marks this category. The setting applies to No-Intro / Redump collections.
filters.tooltip_no_effect_softlist_categ: Without effect on a software of a MAME list: its description never marks this category. The setting applies to the No-Intro / Redump collections.
filters.dumps_no_effect_mame: No effect on a MAME set (its alternate sets are set in the MAME machines card): these settings apply to No-Intro / Redump collections.
filters.dumps_no_effect_softlist: Without effect on a software of a MAME list (a ROM marked "baddump" is the best dump known): these settings apply to the No-Intro / Redump collections.
filters.chk_mame_complete_sets_only: Complete sets only (ROMs and CHDs present)
filters.tooltip_mame_complete_sets: Only keep the MAME sets that have all their ROMs and all their disks (CHDs), including those they find in the set of their BIOS; the others are excluded. An incomplete set a kept game needs is sorted anyway.
filters.tooltip_keep_mame_modifications: Keep the sets whose MAME description says they were modified (hack, hacked), as well as the No-Intro / Redump ROMs marked with (Hack): this setting is shared by all three. Unchecked, they are excluded.
filters.tooltip_keep_mame_pirate: Keep the bootlegs: unofficial copies of a game, often on other hardware, as well as the No-Intro / Redump ROMs marked with (Pirate): this setting is shared by all three. Unchecked, they are excluded.
filters.tooltip_keep_mame_dev: Keep the development versions: prototype, proto, beta, alpha, preview or location test in the MAME description, as well as the No-Intro / Redump ROMs marked with (Beta), (Proto), (Sample) or (Pre-Release): this setting is shared by all three. Unchecked, they are excluded.
filters.tooltip_keep_mame_demos: Keep the demonstration versions (demo in the MAME description), as well as the No-Intro / Redump ROMs marked with (Demo), (Kiosk) or (Taikenban): this setting is shared by all three. Unchecked, they are excluded.
filters.tooltip_keep_mame_bios: Keep the BIOS sets (neogeo, pgm...). A non-merged set already holds the ROMs of its BIOS, but in a merged or split collection, the games take them from the BIOS set. Unchecked, they are excluded, except those a kept game needs.
filters.tooltip_keep_mame_devices: Keep the device sets: components MAME does not start by themselves, but that some games need. Unchecked, they are excluded, except those a kept game needs.
filters.tooltip_keep_mame_mechanical: Keep the pinballs, slot machines and other mechanical machines, which MAME only partly emulates. Unchecked, they are excluded.
filters.mame_mechanical_none_kept: No mechanical machine of the DAT has these statuses.
filters.tooltip_mame_mechanical_none_kep: The mechanical machines are kept, but none has a checked status in the DAT: they are all excluded. Check other statuses to keep some.
filters.tooltip_keep_mame_requires_artwo: Keep the machines MAME only shows properly with an external artwork (artwork files installed separately): handheld electronic games, fruit machines, pinballs... Unchecked, they are excluded.
filters.tooltip_keep_mame_nothing_to_dum: Keep the machines with no ROM nor disk to dump: consoles that MAME runs without any file, with the software of its lists, or machines none of whose ROMs was ever dumped. Unchecked, they are excluded: in a merged collection, their archive only holds the ROMs of their clones.
filters.tooltip_mame_driver: Emulation statuses of the machines to keep, as the MAME driver gives them. Any combination is possible: the machines that work, those that do not work yet… Only the DAT made by mame -listxml gives this status: a machine without a status is always kept.
filters.tooltip_mame_driver_good: Keep the machines whose driver has the good status: MAME emulates them properly.
filters.tooltip_mame_driver_imperfect: Keep the machines whose driver has the imperfect status: playable, with flaws in sound, graphics or other features.
filters.tooltip_mame_driver_preliminary: Keep the machines whose driver has the preliminary status: their emulation is incomplete, often unplayable. Almost all mechanical machines are among them.
filters.tooltip_mame_keep_playable: Also keep, whatever their status, the machines whose core (processors, game logic) is well emulated, even if sound, graphics or another feature is only partly emulated or not at all: a silent game, preliminary for lack of sound, is kept. No effect when the three statuses are checked.
filters.mame_no_driver_status_kept: No status checked: only the machines without a status are kept.
filters.tooltip_mame_no_driver_status_ke: No machine the DAT describes with an emulation status is kept, only the devices and the machines of a DAT that does not give this status. Check at least one status.
filters.tooltip_keep_mame_unemulated_sou: Keep the machines whose sound MAME does not emulate, often playable but silent. Unchecked, they are excluded. A machine with no sound hardware at all is not concerned.
filters.tooltip_keep_mame_alternate_sets: Keep the variants of a machine: the sets whose description says "set 2" or more, or "alt". Unchecked, they are excluded; the main set stays. MAME has no dump quality: the No-Intro / Redump dump settings do not apply to its sets.
filters.tooltip_mame_orientation: Screen orientation a machine needs to be kept, from the DAT made by mame -listxml: a screen turned by a quarter turn is vertical. A machine whose DAT does not give its screen is always kept.
filters.tooltip_keep_mame_vector: Keep the machines with a vector screen (Asteroids, Tempest, Star Wars...), which often look disappointing on an ordinary screen. Unchecked, they are excluded.
filters.tooltip_keep_mame_lcd: Keep the electronic games with an LCD screen (Game & Watch, Tiger...), which are not arcade games. Unchecked, they are excluded.
filters.tooltip_mame_players: Number of players a machine must accept to be kept. A machine whose DAT does not give its number of players is always kept.
filters.tooltip_mame_buttons: Number of buttons of your panel: a machine that needs more is excluded. A machine whose DAT does not give its buttons is always kept.
filters.tooltip_mame_controls: Controls of your panel: a machine that uses a missing control is excluded. A machine whose DAT does not give its controls is always kept.
filters.mame_controls_hint: Uncheck the controls your panel lacks: the machines that use them are excluded.
filters.tooltip_mame_control_joystick: Joysticks with 2, 4 or 8 directions, single or double (Robotron, Smash TV).
filters.tooltip_mame_control_analog_stic: Analog sticks, such as those of flight simulators (After Burner).
filters.tooltip_mame_control_paddle: Paddles (Pong) and steering wheels of racing games (Out Run).
filters.tooltip_mame_control_gambling_pa: Mahjong, hanafuda and gambling panels, with many keys.
filters.tooltip_keep_mame_mature: Keep the machines the category file marks "Mature": content for adults. Unchecked, they are excluded.
filters.tooltip_keep_mame_non_arcade: Keep the machines the category file does not class as arcade: consoles, computers, calculators, musical instruments... Unchecked, they are excluded. Only a file that marks the arcade machines (catlist.ini) allows it.
filters.tooltip_mame_genres: Genres of the category file: the machines of an unchecked genre are excluded. A machine without a category is always kept.
filters.mame_genres_hint: Uncheck the genres whose machines you do not want.
filters.mame_arcade_filter_missing: This file does not tell the arcade machines from the others: this filter needs catlist.ini. Uncheck the non-arcade genres instead (Computer, Game Console, Handheld...).
filters.tooltip_mame_genres_keep_all: Keep the machines of every genre.
filters.tooltip_mame_genres_exclude_all: Exclude every genre, then check again only those you want to keep. A genre another category file brings would be kept.
filters.mame_categories_unreadable: Category file not found or unreadable.
filters.mame_categories_none: Choose a category file (catver.ini, catlist.ini) in the Collection step.
filters.tooltip_mame_minimum_rating: Mark out of 100 a rated machine needs to be kept, from the rating file: "70 or more" keeps the "Good", "Very Good" and "Best Games" ranges.
filters.tooltip_keep_mame_unrated: Keep the machines the rating file does not rate: it only rates a few thousand arcade games. Unchecked, they are excluded.
filters.mame_ratings_unreadable: Rating file not found or unreadable.
filters.mame_ratings_none: Choose a rating file (bestgames.ini) in the Collection step.
filters.tooltip_mame_budget: Size the kept sets may take, in GB of 10⁹ bytes as on a memory card: RomSieve keeps the best rated games first, then the smallest, and leaves out those that no longer fit.
filters.mame_budget_hint: Each game counts with its CHDs and the sets it needs (BIOS, devices), counted once.
filters.tooltip_mame_cabinet: Screen, players and buttons of your cabinet: a machine that does not suit it is excluded. A machine whose DAT says nothing is always kept.
filters.tooltip_mame_categories: Machines for adults, non-arcade machines and genres, from the category file chosen in the Collection step. A machine without a category is always kept.
filters.tooltip_mame_ratings: Minimum rating and unrated games, from the rating file chosen in the Collection step.
filters.tooltip_complete_sets_tosec: Only keep multi-disk games whose disks are all present in your collection; the others are excluded (requires the DAT file).
filters.tooltip_complete_sets_nointro: Only keep multi-disc or multi-track games whose media are all present in the source, and the MAME sets that hold all their ROMs and disks; the others are excluded (requires the DAT).
filters.tooltip_amiga_target: Amiga the collection will be used on, from the chipset its TOSEC name gives ((AGA), (OCS-AGA), (ECS-AGA), (A1200)…). A game without a mark is presumed OCS / ECS and is never left out.
filters.amiga_hint_any: Nothing is excluded; the AGA and OCS versions of a game stay two games.
filters.amiga_hint_ocs: The AGA and ECS games are excluded.
filters.amiga_hint_aga: Nothing is excluded. With 1G1R, the AGA and OCS versions of a game are one game, the AGA version first.
